info.title: Shop API
info.description: Public and customer endpoints used by the store.

get.description: The cart with its lines, their states and the totals, all computed by the API (Pricing's quote of the purchasable lines), with the preview of a discount code when one is given. A customer without a cart gets an empty one with `id: null`, and none is created; an expired cart (180 days after its last change) is empty.

post.summary: Merge a guest cart into the cart of the customer
post.description: Moves the lines of the guest cart into the cart of the customer, in one transaction: the quantities of a variant in both are added and cut to 99, a variant of the guest beyond the 50th of the cart is skipped (either makes `truncated` true); price and availability are not checked. The guest cart is then merged and every later change of it is a 404. An expired cart of the customer is cleared first. A merged guest cart gives `already_merged`; an unknown or expired guest cart, or the id of a customer cart, gives `nothing_to_merge`; neither changes anything nor creates a cart, and `cart` is the cart as `GET /api/v1/me/cart` gives it.

200.description: The cart of the customer and how the merge ended.

get.summary: Offers of products of the list
get.description: For each requested product its variants (label, current gross price, availability level, whether one unit can be bought now), the lowest price among the purchasable variants (`fromGross`, with `hasPriceRange` when their prices differ) and the best level among them; a product without a purchasable variant, also one unknown to Catalog, has no price and is `out_of_stock`. The number of units is never returned. Send the ids as a repeated `productId` key (`?productId=<uuid>&productId=<uuid>`); the `productId[]` form is not accepted. The response is public and tagged for purging: a shared cache keeps it until a change of a price or an availability level purges it (an hour at most). It does not decide a purchase: an addition to the cart checks the price and the stock again.

200.description: One offer per requested product, in the order of the request; a repeated id answers once.

400.description: No id, more than 48 ids, or an id that is not a UUID (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: An access token was sent and is invalid (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`). No token is needed.

503.description: A token was sent and the keys of its issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without technical details).

get.description: The whole category tree. Siblings at every level are sorted by name (Polish collation).

200.description: Root categories with their descendants. Every node has its `slug` (unique among its siblings) and `path` (the slugs from the root to the node joined with `/`, e.g. `turystyka/biwak/namioty`). An empty catalogue gives an empty array.

401.description: An access token was sent and is invalid (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`). No token is needed.

503.description: A token was sent and the keys of its issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: A page of products, optionally searched by a phrase and narrowed by filters, with the counts that go with it (`facets`). The category filter includes the products of all its subcategories; an unknown category gives 404, an existing category without products an empty list. A page past the end gives an empty list with the real total. Without `sort` the list is by relevance with `q` and by name otherwise. The conditions on variants (`option`, `priceMin`, `priceMax`, `available`) all hold for one and the same variant of a product: `option=Kolor:czarne&option=Rozmiar:42` finds products with a black variant in size 42, not a black one and a different one in size 42. Prices and availability count only variants that can be bought now. Several values of one axis mean "any of them", different axes mean "all". Send `option` as a repeated key (`?option=Kolor:czarne&option=Kolor:biały`); the `option[]` form is not accepted. The response is public, kept for 60 s and tagged for purging, so a new price or stock level can show in the filters after up to a minute.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search phrase, 2 to 100 characters after trimming. Every word must match (name, category names or short description), Polish inflection, missing Polish characters and small typos are tolerated.

parameters.name: option
parameters.description: Wanted variant option as `<axis>:<value>`, split on the first colon (axis 1 to 30 characters, value 1 to 40), repeated for more; at most 50 entries of at most 5 different axes.

parameters.name: priceMin
parameters.description: Lowest gross price of a buyable variant, in grosze.

parameters.name: priceMax
parameters.description: Highest gross price of a buyable variant, in grosze; not lower than `priceMin`.

parameters.name: available
parameters.description: Only products with a variant that can be bought now. The only accepted value is `true`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: `relevance` (only with `q`; the default with `q`), `name` (the default without `q`), `price_asc`, `price_desc` (by the lowest price of a buyable variant, products without one last). Ties break by name, then by id.

401.description: An access token was sent and is invalid (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`). No token is needed.

404.description: The `category` filter names a category that does not exist (problem details).

503.description: The search service is unavailable, or a token was sent and the keys of its issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without technical details).

get.description: The product page data: the category path from the root to the main category, all the images in position order, the variant axes and the variants (label and values in the order of the axes) in position order. The price and the availability are in the product offer. A slug that names no published product (a draft, an unknown slug, one that is not in the format of a slug) gives 404. The 200 may be kept by a shared cache for an hour and is tagged for purging; the 404 for 60 seconds, tagged for purging when the product is published.

401.description: An access token was sent and is invalid (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`). No token is needed.

get.description: The chunks that the product sitemap is cut into, in the order of the product id. Every product, published or not, belongs to exactly one chunk; the first chunk reaches back to the lowest id and the last to the highest, so a product created after the chunks were cut is in one of them. The key of a chunk is opaque: pass it unchanged to `getSitemapProducts`. An empty catalogue has one chunk. The chunks are cut from the ids of all the products and the cut is kept for an hour, so a new product can move the cut only after that. The response is public, kept for 60 s by a browser and for an hour by a shared cache, and tagged for purging.

401.description: An access token was sent and is invalid (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`). No token is needed.

503.description: A token was sent and the keys of its issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.summary: Products of one chunk of the product sitemap
get.description: The published products of the chunk, in the order of the product id, with the slug and the time of the last change of the product (prices and stock levels do not change it). A chunk without published products has an empty list. The number of rows read from the range of the chunk is bounded, drafts included: past the limit the published ones among the rows read are returned, and the rest comes with the next cut of the chunks. The response is public and kept by a browser for 5 minutes; it is not tagged and the Varnish of the store does not keep it, so its freshness is the short `max-age`.

parameters.name: chunk
parameters.description: Key of the chunk, as the chunk list issued it.

200.description: The published products of the chunk.

post.summary: Place an order of the cart of the customer
post.description: Orders every line of the cart of the customer in one transaction: the quantities come from the cart, the prices from Pricing and the names from Catalog at this moment, the units are reserved and the cart is emptied. The email is the one of the token (an `email` key is ignored); the body carries no lines, quantities or prices, unknown keys are ignored. `expectedTotalGross` is only compared with the computed gross total. The optional `discountCode` (the code of the checkout) discounts the order: its gross total is after the discount and the usage of the code is recorded with the order (once, also on a replay). The `Idempotency-Key` identifies the request: sending it again with the same content answers 200 with the same order and changes nothing; the same key used by another customer, a guest or with other content is a 409 that tells nothing about the order.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Key of the request, chosen by the client (e.g. a UUID made when the checkout opens) and sent again on a retry: 1 to 100 characters, letters, digits, ".", "_", ":" or "-".

200.description: The order of an earlier request of the customer with this key and the same content: nothing changed.

400.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing or malformed (problem details with `violations`), or the body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token, also one of the `backoffice` realm (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

409.description: The cart is empty (also without a cart or with an expired one), has a line that cannot be bought (no current price, unknown variant), more units than available (never told how many), a gross total other than `expectedTotalGross` (after the discount of the code), a discount code that gives no discount (invalid, used up, or the subtotal below its minimum), or the key was used by another request. Problem details with a stable `type` for each cause (see `OrderConflictProblem`) and a Polish `detail`. Nothing is ordered or reserved.

422.description: A key is missing, of a wrong type or invalid (problem details with Polish `violations`, one per field).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Place an order of a guest cart
post.description: Orders every line of the guest cart in one transaction: the quantities come from the cart, the prices from Pricing and the names from Catalog at this moment, the units are reserved and the cart is emptied (it stays open). The body carries no lines, quantities or prices; unknown keys are ignored. `expectedTotalGross` is only compared with the computed gross total. The optional `discountCode` (the code of the checkout) discounts the order: its gross total is after the discount and the usage of the code is recorded with the order (once, also on a replay). The `Idempotency-Key` identifies the request: sending it again with the same cart and content answers 200 with the same order and changes nothing, also once the cart expired or was merged; the same key with another cart or other content is a 409 that tells nothing about the order. The order cannot be read later, so there is no `Location`.

post.summary: Start a payment of an order of a guest
post.description: Opens a session at the chosen provider for the gross total of the order, valid until its payment deadline, and answers where to send the customer (`redirectUrl`). A pending payment of the order is cancelled at its provider first; when that provider executed it already, nothing changes (409 `payment-in-progress`). The `Idempotency-Key` identifies the request: the same key for the same order and provider answers 200 with that payment as it is now; with another order or provider it is a 409. The access is checked before the key, so the key alone never gives a payment.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Id of the order (`orderId` of the placed order).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Key of the request, chosen by the client (new for every attempt and every change of provider, the same on a retry of an uncertain result): 1 to 100 characters, letters, digits, ".", "_", ":" or "-".

200.description: The payment of an earlier request with this key for the same order and provider, as it is now.

400.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing or malformed (problem details with `violations`), or the body is not valid JSON (problem details).

409.description: The order is paid, cancelled or past its deadline, another payment is in progress (a concurrent start, or the pending one was executed at its provider), or the key was used by another request. Problem details with a stable `type` (see `PaymentConflictProblem`) and a Polish `detail`.

get.description: Every provider a customer can choose in the checkout, with the name to show, in the order to show them.

post.description: Called by the provider (not by the store) when a payment session is paid or refused. The signature of the raw body is verified first: `demo-transfer` sends `X-Signature` (hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body), `demo-card` sends `Card-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<body>">` valid for 300 s. Each event is handled once (by its id); a repeated delivery answers 204 and changes nothing. A succeeded payment pays its order when it was executed before the payment deadline; otherwise (or for a cancelled order, or an order paid by another payment) it is kept for a refund by hand.

parameters.name: X-Signature
parameters.description: `demo-transfer`: hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the webhook secret.

requestBody.description: The event as the provider sends it. `demo-transfer`: `{eventId, transactionId, merchantRef, status: PAID | REJECTED, amount (grosze), currency, paidAt (RFC 3339, with PAID)}`. `demo-card`: `{id, type: checkout.completed | checkout.failed, data: {sessionId, reference, amount ("123.45"), currency, completedAt (Unix seconds, with checkout.completed)}}`; other types are acknowledged and ignored.

204.description: The event was handled, was handled before, or is of a type the shop ignores.

400.description: Missing or wrong signature, a timestamp outside the tolerance, or a body that breaks the format of the provider (problem details, one text for every cause).

401.description: An access token of a session was sent and is invalid (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`). None is needed.

404.description: Unknown provider, or no payment of the session at this provider (problem details).

422.description: The amount is not the amount of the payment; nothing changed (problem details).

503.description: The order changed concurrently; nothing changed and the provider retries (problem details without detail).

total.description: All products matching the filter, not only this page.

ProductFacets.description: Counts for the filters of the list. Each one is computed with every condition of the search except its own. The count of an axis value is the number of products that have a variant with that value meeting the other variant conditions (other axes, price, availability). For an axis without a selection it is the `total` the search would return after adding that value; for an axis with a selection it is the result of selecting only that value of the axis.

categories.description: The subcategories of the `category` filter (the top-level categories without it) that have products, in the order of the category tree.

options.description: The variant axes of the products found, most products first (at most 10; the selected axes are always listed, beyond that limit). A selected value stays in its list with a count of 0 when nothing matches.

price.description: The lowest and the highest gross price of the variants that can be bought now and have the selected `option` values, ignoring `priceMin` and `priceMax`; null without such a variant.

availableCount.description: The `total` the search would return with `available=true` added.

path.description: The slugs from the top-level category joined with `/`.

count.description: The products of the category (and its subcategories) found, with the variant conditions of the search.

values.description: Most products first, then by value (at most 30; the selected values are always listed, beyond that limit).

count.description: The number of products that have a variant with this value meeting the other variant conditions (other axes, price, availability). For an axis without a selection it is the `total` after adding the value; for an axis with a selection, the result of selecting only this value of the axis.

image.description: The main image, null when the product has no images.

ProductImage.description: A product image of one predefined size, with signed URLs of its variants grouped by output format.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio of every variant, width:height.

variants.description: Variants by output format (the key is the file extension, e.g. webp), widths ascending.

ZoomImage.description: A product image in the `zoom` size, the whole image without cropping (no fixed aspect ratio), with signed URLs of its variants grouped by output format.

variants.description: Variants by output format (the key is the file extension, e.g. webp), widths ascending. The height follows the width and the proportions of the original; an original narrower than the width is not enlarged.

breadcrumb.description: The categories from the root to the main category of the product.

images.description: All the images of the product in position order, the first is the main one (size `product`).

zoomImages.description: The same images as `images`, in the same order and number, in the `zoom` size (the whole image for the enlargement).

variantAxes.description: Names of the variant axes, in order; empty for a product with one default variant.

path.description: The slugs from the root to this category joined with `/`, as `path` of `CategoryNode`.

label.description: The values joined with a comma; empty for the default variant.

values.description: One value per axis, in the order of the axes.

CartView.description: A cart with everything the store shows, computed by the API. The number of available units is never part of it.

id.description: Id of the cart; null for a customer who has no cart yet.

lines.description: The lines in the order they were added.

hasExcludedLines.description: Whether a line is not purchasable and so not part of the totals.

discount.description: The discount code of the read (`discountCode`), applied or rejected; null without a code, for a blank one and for a cart without a purchasable line (no quote). Changes of the cart answer without a code.

AppliedCartDiscount.description: A code the quote applied to the purchasable lines.

code.description: The code in its normalised form (upper case).

amountGross.description: The discount in grosze, at least 1; `totals.gross` is `totals.subtotalGross` less it.

value.description: The percent (1–90) of a `percent` code, the amount in grosze of an `amount` code.

RejectedCartDiscount.description: A code the quote did not apply; the totals are without discount.

code.description: The code as read (trimmed, ASCII letters in upper case).

reason.description: `invalid`: unknown, disabled, not started or expired (also a text that is no code); `used_up`: the usage limit is reached; `below_minimum`: the subtotal is below the minimum of the code.

detail.description: The Polish message for the customer, the same as the `detail` of the 409 of an order with the code.
detail.example: Ten kod jest nieprawidłowy albo nieaktywny.

minimumOrderGross.description: The smallest subtotal in grosze the code works from, only for `below_minimum`.

variantId.description: The variant of a product the line holds; the lines are unique by variant.

product.description: Null when Catalog no longer knows the variant (`unavailable_product`).

unitPrice.description: The current (effective) gross price, for a purchasable line from Pricing's quote; null without a current price.

lineTotal.description: Unit price × quantity before the discount code, only for a `purchasable` line.

state.description: The first that applies: the variant is unknown to Catalog, has no current price, has no available unit, has fewer available units than the quantity; otherwise purchasable.

CartLineProduct.description: The product of the variant of the line.

variantLabel.description: The values of the variant joined with ", "; empty for the default variant of a product without variant axes.

image.description: The main image in the listing size, null when the product has no images.

CartTotals.description: The totals of Pricing's quote of the purchasable lines; all 0 without a purchasable line.

subtotalGross.description: Sum of the `lineTotal` of the purchasable lines in grosze, before the discount code.

discountGross.description: The discount of the applied code in grosze, 0 without one.

gross.description: The total to pay in grosze, `subtotalGross` − `discountGross`.

itemCount.description: Units of every line, purchasable or not (the counter in the header).

MergeResult.description: The cart of the customer after a merge of a guest cart.

result.description: `merged`: the guest lines moved; `already_merged`: the guest cart was merged before; `nothing_to_merge`: the guest cart is unknown, expired or a customer cart. Only `merged` changes anything.

truncated.description: Whether a sum was cut to 99 units or a variant of the guest skipped because the cart had 50 variants; always false unless `merged`.

itemCount.description: Units of every line of the cart.

OrderView.description: An order as it was placed, with copies of the names and prices of that moment. Amounts in grosze; the totals are after the discount of the code.

number.description: The number the customer is told, `R-` and a number from 100001.

email.description: The address the order is confirmed to.

lines.description: The lines of the cart, in its order.

discount.description: The discount code the order was placed with; null without one.

placedAt.description: When the order was placed (RFC 3339, UTC).

paymentDeadline.description: The order is to be paid by this moment, 30 minutes after the placement (RFC 3339, UTC).

accessToken.description: The key of a guest to the order (starting a payment, reading its status), 43 characters of base64url; the same on a replay. Null for an order of a customer, who reaches it with the token of the session.

variantLabel.description: The values of the variant joined with ", "; empty for the default variant of a product without variant axes.

unitGross.description: Gross price of one unit in grosze (the effective price, with a promotion if any).

grossBeforeDiscount.description: Unit gross price × quantity, in grosze, before the discount of the code.

discountGross.description: The share of the line in the discount of the code, in grosze; 0 without a code.

lineGross.description: The value of the line after the discount (`grossBeforeDiscount` − `discountGross`), in grosze.

OrderDiscount.description: The copy of the discount code of an order, as it was when the order was placed.

code.description: The code in its normalised form (upper case).

value.description: The percent (1–90) of a `percent` code, the amount in grosze of an `amount` code.

amountGross.description: The discount of the order in grosze, the sum of `discountGross` of its lines.

OrderTotals.description: Sums of the lines after the discount of the code; net + vat = gross.

CustomerOrderStatus.description: `new` (waits for the payment; right after the placement), `paid`, `shipped`, `delivered`, `cancelled` (unpaid in time, or by staff), `returned`.

CustomerOrderList.description: A page of the order history of the customer.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page (send it as `after`), null on the last page.

CustomerOrderListItem.description: An order in the history. Amounts in grosze.

itemCount.description: Units of all lines of the order.

paymentDeadline.description: The order was to be paid by this moment (RFC 3339, UTC); meaningful for a `new` order.

paymentDeadlinePassed.description: True only for a `new` order whose `paymentDeadline` has come, computed by the API; false for every other status.

CustomerOrder.description: An order of the customer with copies of the names and prices of the placement. Amounts in grosze. No history of changes, notes, data of staff, refund or payment.

discount.description: The discount code the order was placed with; null without one.

paymentDeadline.description: The order was to be paid by this moment, 30 minutes after the placement (RFC 3339, UTC).

paymentDeadlinePassed.description: True only for a `new` order whose `paymentDeadline` has come, computed by the API; false for every other status.

paidAt.description: When the payment was confirmed (RFC 3339, UTC); null until then.

shippedAt.description: When the order was shipped (RFC 3339, UTC); null until then.

deliveredAt.description: When the order was delivered (RFC 3339, UTC); null until then, and for an order returned without being delivered.

cancelledAt.description: When the order was cancelled (RFC 3339, UTC); null for an order that was not.

returnedAt.description: When the return was received (RFC 3339, UTC); null for an order that was not returned.

PaymentView.description: A payment of an order at a provider.

status.description: `pending` until the provider confirms the payment (`succeeded`) or refuses it (`failed`); `cancelled` when a newer attempt cancelled it at the provider.

redirectUrl.description: The page of the provider where the customer pays.

PaymentStatusView.description: The order and its newest payment, as the confirmation page shows them. Amounts in grosze.

paymentDeadline.description: The order is to be paid by this moment (RFC 3339, UTC).

canStartPayment.description: Whether a payment can be started now (the order is new and before its deadline). A new attempt cancels a pending payment at its provider first.

latestPayment.description: The newest payment of the order, null before the first one.

resumeUrl.description: The page of the provider of a pending payment, to go back to it while the order is payable; null otherwise.

PaymentConflictProblem.description: A 409 of the payment endpoints. `type` names the cause (the `detail` is Polish text for people and may change): the order is paid, the order is cancelled or past its payment deadline, another payment of the order is in progress (a concurrent start, or the pending payment was executed at its provider and waits for its confirmation), or the `Idempotency-Key` was used by another request.

detail.description: Present only for 4xx errors, never for 5xx.

violations.description: Present only for 400 (invalid query parameters) or 422 (invalid request body) caused by invalid input.

title.example: This is not a valid UUID.

OrderConflictProblem.description: A 409 of the order endpoints. `type` names the cause (the `detail` is Polish text for people and may change): the cart is empty (also without a cart or with an expired one), has a line that cannot be bought (no current price, unknown variant), has fewer units in stock than ordered, has a gross total other than `expectedTotalGross`, the `Idempotency-Key` was used by another request, or the discount code gives no discount: unknown, disabled, not started or expired (`discount-code-invalid`), its usage limit reached (`discount-code-used-up`) or the subtotal before it below its minimum (`discount-code-below-minimum`, with `minimumOrderGross`). The `detail` of a code is the one of the rejected code in the cart.

minimumOrderGross.description: Only for `discount-code-below-minimum`, the smallest subtotal in grosze the code works from.

AddCartItemRequest.description: A variant of a product to add to the cart.

quantity.description: Units to add, from 1 to 99. The line of the variant may have at most 99 units.

ChangeCartItemQuantityRequest.description: The new quantity of a line.

MergeGuestCartRequest.description: The guest cart to merge into the cart of the customer.

PlaceCustomerOrderRequest.description: The contact and the address of an order of the cart of the customer, the total the customer saw and the discount code applied.

fullName.description: Full name, 1 to 100 characters once trimmed.

phone.description: A Polish phone number: 9 digits, optionally after +48; spaces and hyphens are allowed and dropped. The order keeps +48 and the 9 digits.

street.description: Street and number, 1 to 100 characters once trimmed.

city.description: City, 1 to 60 characters once trimmed. The country is always Poland.

expectedTotalGross.description: The gross total of the cart the customer saw, in grosze (`totals.gross` of the cart). Only compared with the total the API computes; another one is a 409.

discountCode.description: The discount code the customer applied in the checkout, optional: a missing key, `null`, an empty text or one of white space only is no code. Compared without letter case. A code that gives no discount is a 409 with its own `type`; the order is not placed.

PlaceGuestOrderRequest.description: The guest cart, the contact and the address of an order, the total the guest saw and the discount code applied.

cartId.description: Id of the guest cart: a UUID, 8-4-4-4-12 hex digits in any letter case. An unknown, expired or merged cart, or the id of a customer cart, is a 404.

email.description: Email address the order is confirmed to, at most 254 characters once trimmed, one the mailer accepts (no empty part between dots).

fullName.description: Full name, 1 to 100 characters once trimmed.

phone.description: A Polish phone number: 9 digits, optionally after +48; spaces and hyphens are allowed and dropped. The order keeps +48 and the 9 digits.

street.description: Street and number, 1 to 100 characters once trimmed.

city.description: City, 1 to 60 characters once trimmed. The country is always Poland.

expectedTotalGross.description: The gross total of the cart the guest saw, in grosze (`totals.gross` of the cart). Only compared with the total the API computes; another one is a 409.

discountCode.description: The discount code the customer applied in the checkout, optional: a missing key, `null`, an empty text or one of white space only is no code. Compared without letter case. A code that gives no discount is a 409 with its own `type`; the order is not placed.

provider.description: Code of the provider, one of `GET /api/v1/payment-providers`.

FromPromotionResponse.description: The promotion of the variant that gives the "from" price of a product.

lowestPriorGross.description: The lowest gross price in grosze of the 30 days before the start of the promotion (the Omnibus price); null when the variant had no price before the start.

VariantOfferPromotionResponse.description: The promotion that gives the price of a variant now.

endsAt.description: The end of the promotion in UTC (RFC 3339, whole seconds); the promotion lasts until before it.

lowestPriorGross.description: The lowest gross price in grosze of the 30 days before the start of the promotion (the Omnibus price); null when the variant had no price before the start.

VariantOfferResponse.description: The offer of one variant of a product. Never the number of units.

variantId.description: Variant id (UUID): the key of a cart line.

label.description: The values of the variant joined with ", "; empty for the default variant of a product without axes.

gross.description: The current gross price in grosze, the price to pay: in a promotion the promotional price; null without a current price.

regularGross.description: The catalog gross price in grosze (equal to `gross` outside a promotion); null without a current price.

promotion.description: The promotion that gives `gross`; null outside a promotion.

level.description: Availability level computed by the API.

purchasable.description: Whether one unit can be bought now: a current price and an available unit. The tile offers only such a variant.

ProductOfferResponse.description: The offer of a product of the list, computed by the API from its purchasable variants (a current price and an available unit). Never the number of units.

variantAxes.description: Names of the variant axes in order (e.g. "Kolor, Rozmiar"); empty for a product with the default variant only, and for a product unknown to Catalog.

fromGross.description: The lowest current (in a promotion: promotional) gross price in grosze among the purchasable variants; null when no variant can be bought.

fromPromotion.description: The promotion of the variant that gives `fromGross` (of variants of the same price, the first in order); null when that variant is not in a promotion or no variant can be bought.

hasPriceRange.description: Whether the purchasable variants have different prices (the tile shows "od").

level.description: The best level among the purchasable variants; out_of_stock when no variant can be bought.

variants.description: Every variant in presentation order; none for a product unknown to Catalog.

ProductOfferListResponse.description: One offer per requested product, in the order of the request; a repeated id answers once.

MeResponse.description: The customer identified by the access token.

id.description: Customer id, the `sub` of the token.

name.description: Full name, empty when the account has none.

shop.description: Access token issued by the `shop` realm (customers).
